ck: kartrtvan tvivitaniti kartrtvavipakapratipatakapEnkitisrute sapranananapisantinirupanan tatahi tatayan kartrtvan tvivitanityatipEnkisrutyarta: kartrtvan tvivitan proktan vikarasca svatantrata vikara: prakrtereva visnoreva svatantrata iti cetanakataneva kartrtvan tvivitan prakrtanaprakrtan ceti tatraprakrtan svecatinapravrtinatvarupan sarvata pakavata eva tatitanuktan visnoreva svatantrateti nuktyanantaran civantarasyapi sansare tu isakotivyatiriktasarvacetananan prakrtaneva prakrtivikaro puticaprayatnapurvakaparispantarupan tata ca civasya yatkartrtvan (civasvanikan puticaprayatnapurvakaparispantarupan) tatprakrtervikaraputan tateva ca prakrte kartrtvanityucyate tatitanuktan vikara prakrtereveti tatyata cetanakaranasyapi parasortevatatakaranatvavyavaharo tevatatasya karanan parasuriti yata ca tevatatapokayatanatvatehasya, tevatatasya teha iti vyavahara, evan tasyEva pancaputavikaratvat ‘putapancakasya teha ityapyucyate nEtavata putapancakasya prtakteha ukto pavati evaneva tevatatasya (tevatatasvanikan ) yatkartrtvan tasya canta:karanatiprakrtivikaratvat prakrte kartrtvaniti vyavahriyate nEtavata prakrte prtak kartrtvanuktan pavati anyata civakartrtvasyatranukternyunata syat …. 1 vipakapotakesnin vakye svatantratapratitvantvitaya prakrtavikarasya krahanatsvatantrataya aprakrtatvan vicnayata iti pava 2 cakatatnana vikarasya kartrtarupatvaniti pava: 3 uktaritya vipakaparatvakatana ityarta …. tatitanapipretyEvetan vacanan prahnatarkavacananca civakartrtvaprasanka evotahrtanacaryE tatanena vacanena civakartrtvasya prakrtasatvatikunopateyatvan, pratanyena pakavatkartrtvaninitakatvan coktan pavati tata ca prakrtercakatatnana vikarasya kartrtarupatvasyatranukteretatvakyotaharanapurvakan vyapicaracotana sarvatayuktEva
